concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-reporting-balance-transfers]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Adyen guide to settlement-batch balance transfers, using Company Payout reason codes and Settlement details batch-direction/net-amount entries; report movement is not proof of bank receipt or final payout.
warnings: Company Payout and Settlement details answer different reconciliation questions; reason-code actions and example debit rows must not be generalized to every transfer or treated as final bank or accounting outcomes.
